info.description: Standalone multi-tenant Identity Provider — email/password auth, JWT, refresh tokens, TOTP 2FA, SAML 2.0, RBAC, Admin UI, and AI/Agent security.
info.title: EMC Auth Server

get.description: Returns all active agent registrations for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates an agent registration and returns the raw API key once. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns risk-scored analysis for all active agents in the tenant. Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Revokes an agent registration belonging to the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns all active API keys for the caller's tenant. The raw key is never included.

post.description: Creates a new API key for machine-to-machine auth. The raw key is returned exactly once.

delete.description: Permanently revokes an API key. The key is immediately invalid.

get.description: Returns all per-app rate limit configs for the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Sets a custom per-minute request limit for an application identified by X-App-ID. Requires admin:access.

409.description: app_id already has a rate limit config

put.description: Updates the rate limit config for an existing app_id in the tenant. Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Removes the custom rate limit for an app_id; it falls back to the default limit. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns all active applications for the caller's tenant.

post.description: Registers a new application for the tenant. Returns client_id and client_secret — secret is shown exactly once.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an application. Its client_id is immediately rejected on login and register.

get.description: Returns paginated audit events scoped to the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.
Returns paginated audit events across ALL tenants. Requires tenant:manage (super_admin only).
Returns all permissions for the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates a new permission within the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

409.description: Permission name already exists in this tenant

delete.description: Deletes a permission from the caller's tenant. Cascades to roles and users. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns all roles in the caller's tenant with their permission lists. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Creates a role in the caller's tenant with optional permission assignments. Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Deletes a non-system role from the tenant. Users assigned this role will have their role cleared. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Replaces the permission set on a role. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns the SAML IdP configuration for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Upserts the SAML IdP configuration for the requesting tenant. Requires admin:access.
put.summary: Create or update tenant SAML configuration

get.description: Returns audit-log-based activity counts scoped to the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.
Returns audit-log-based activity counts across all tenants. Requires tenant:manage permission.
Returns a paginated, filtered list of tenants. Requires tenant:manage permission.

parameters.description: Search by name, display name, or domain
parameters.name: search

parameters.description: Filter by status: active or inactive
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a new isolated tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission (super_admin only).

get.description: Returns whether a tenant slug is available. Always responds 200. Requires tenant:manage permission.
Returns system-wide tenant, application, and user counts with month-over-month deltas. Requires tenant:manage permission.
Returns a single tenant by ID. Requires tenant:manage permission.

put.description: Updates editable fields on a tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.

delete.description: Soft-deactivates a tenant (sets is_active=false). Requires tenant:manage permission.

put.description: Sets is_active=true for a previously deactivated tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
Replaces the list of allowed CORS origins for a tenant. Pass an empty array to disable CORS enforcement. Requires tenant:manage.

get.description: Returns all permissions belonging to the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
get.summary: List permissions for a target tenant

post.description: Adds a new permission to the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
post.summary: Create permission in a target tenant

delete.description: Removes a permission from the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
delete.summary: Delete permission from a target tenant

get.description: Returns all roles (with permissions) belonging to the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage permission.
get.summary: List roles for a target tenant

post.description: Creates a role and optionally assigns permissions to it. Requires tenant:manage permission.
post.summary: Create role in a target tenant

delete.description: Permanently deletes a role from the target tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
delete.summary: Delete a role from a target tenant

put.description: Replaces the full permission set on a role in the target tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
put.summary: Replace permissions on a target-tenant role

get.description: Returns paginated users for the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
get.summary: List users in a target tenant

post.description: Creates a new user in the specified tenant. Requires tenant:manage.
post.summary: Create a user in a target tenant

delete.description: Marks the user as deleted (is_deleted=true). Requires tenant:manage.
delete.summary: Soft-delete a user from a target tenant

get.description: Returns a paginated, searchable list of users in the caller's tenant. Requires admin:access.

parameters.description: Search by email, first name, or last name
parameters.name: search

post.description: Creates a user in the caller's tenant with an optional role. Requires admin:access.

get.description: Returns a user's details. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Updates a user's profile (email, name). Requires admin:access.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a user (is_deleted=true, is_active=false). ID preserved for audit. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified user. Requires admin:access.

put.description: Sets the user's role within the tenant. Requires admin:access.

post.description: Validates an agent API key and returns a signed short-lived JWT. Public — no prior auth required.
post.summary: Authenticate an agent and issue a JWT

post.description: Sends a reset link to the email address. ALWAYS returns 200 regardless of whether the email is registered (prevents email enumeration).
Authenticates an existing user and returns a JWT access token + refresh token pair.
Submit the TOTP code (or backup code) to complete a two-step login.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Idempotent — calling twice is safe.
Authenticates an API key (X-API-Key or Authorization: ApiKey) and returns a short-lived management JWT valid for 15 minutes. Use the returned token as Bearer auth on admin endpoints.
post.summary: Exchange API key for management JWT

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile decoded from the JWT.
Returns the authenticated user's own recent audit log entries.

delete.description: Disables TOTP for the current user. Requires a valid TOTP code or backup code.

post.description: Verifies the first TOTP code and marks the enrollment active.
Generates a TOTP secret and returns an otpauth:// URI plus backup codes.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair and immediately invalidates the old refresh token.
Creates a user account in the specified tenant and returns a token pair.
Validates the reset token, updates the user's password, and revokes all active refresh tokens.
Authenticates the user and stores tokens in HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies.
Revokes the refresh token stored in the cookie and clears both auth cookies.
Rotates the access and refresh tokens using the refresh cookie.
Issues a service-level access token using client_id + client_secret. No user involved, no refresh token issued.
Receives IdP SAMLResponse. Currently returns 501 — disabled until IdP XML signature verification is implemented.

get.description: Redirects the browser to the configured IdP with a signed SAMLRequest.
Returns SAML Service Provider metadata XML for the given tenant. Used by IdPs to configure the SP.

request_count.description: total audit events attributed to this agent

expires_at.description: UTC unix timestamp when access token expires
